rule.text: a second press during a cast is refused. During a GCD, one queued sample (~0.23 s left) and one dropped sample (~1.68 s left) bound the window only between about 0.23 s and 1.68 s; 0.25 s is not measured. The queued skill's new GCD starts about 0.2 s after the current GCD ends, the same press->rise lag as a normal press, so that delay is our reply/pipeline latency, not a queue rule

caveats: Our server's replies (SCCombatCleared, SCSkillStarted, SCSkillFired, damage ticks, refusals) are stimulus, not 1.2 server evidence.
The character died before run2 (the gap while the runs were analysed); run2 is invalid and kept only for the 'Can't be used while dead.' row.
The first K2 target was already 155 HP down at the find; the auto-attack may have been on from the pre-run probe.
The K2 re-press sent another CSStartSkill 2 (no stop packet) and our server stopped the damage; a client auto-attack toggle is not proven.
The K2 no-target press sent nothing; the script cleared the target and our server sent SCCombatCleared.
The K2 out-of-range press sent CSStartSkill 2; our server accepted it as a repeat start and did nothing.
The weapon byte weapon_active stayed 1 after the first draw; no sheathe was observed. The stance evidence is the stance_perm byte.
The client's system clock drifted 813 ppm in run; the UI clock is the stable reference. Input-to-UI comparisons are within the 52 ms frame plus the clock residual.
